result.summary: The page is largely well-formed: the layout is clean, the header, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation align properly, and no elements overlap or render incorrectly. I found only minor issues: duplicated card content, redundant delivery-fee information, and some low-contrast grey secondary text. The clipped chips, the clipped 'Smash Bros' card, and the partially visible pizza card were excluded per the instructions.

issues.description: The two 'Fastest near you' cards are identical (same image, same name 'Green Bowl Poké', same delivery time and fee), which looks like a duplicated data entry or placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source and show distinct restaurants, or remove the duplicate card.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below it.
issues.suggestion: Remove one of the two repeated delivery-fee indicators to reduce clutter.

issues.description: Secondary grey text (search placeholder, delivery fees, '(500+)' review count, inactive bottom nav labels) appears to have low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the grey text to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 for body text).
